source_baseline.working_tree: Existing authorized governance implementation in progress; snapshot retained untouched

scope: Dedicated compact artwork for two communist decision categories and eight decisions; original focus/idea DDS and existing GFX/manifests remain untouched by artwork subtask
method: Reused permitted local PNG pieces, freshly composed at native decision sizes, plus existing continuation-authored check mark and a simple regional link. No AI generation or download.

permission.basis: Upstream declares contributor consent and all free to use. Applies only to the selected pack files, not all artwork from contributing mods; no separate MIT/CC license inferred.
permission.attribution: Globvs / Ultimate HOI4 GFX contributors; individual artist not mapped per file in upstream CREDITS
permission.continuation: kpopmodder: small-size composition, isolated background recolor, simple link/check marks and export. Original PNG authorship retained.

native_ui.dds_header: Category: native 51x40 header. Row: same verified uncompressed BGRA32 single-level header, width/height/pitch set to32/32/128. mipmapCount remains0. Native row with mipmapCount5 is evidence of UI mapping only; none of its pixels/header is copied.
native_ui.attribution: Paradox Interactive: native UI/DDS technical format reference; no vanilla illustration pixels used

palette.mask_rule: A > 0 and R-G > 6 and R-B > 3 and B-G >= -4
palette.scope: Background layer only; no hue filter on metal border or central pieces
